name: North Macedonia

flag.description: A red field with a yellow stylised sun in the centre, from which eight broadening yellow rays extend to the edges and corners.
flag.symbolism: The sun represents the 'new sun of liberty' mentioned in the national anthem.

hook: A golden sun bursting eight rays all the way to the edges on red: North Macedonia's rays reach the border, while Kyrgyzstan's compact sun stays in the middle.
trivia: The current flag replaced a 1992 design showing the Vergina Sun after Greece objected to its use.
The country added 'North' to its name in 2019 under the Prespa Agreement with Greece.
